bio.text: Shannon Taylor, the Henrico County commonwealth's attorney, won the August 4, 2026 Democratic primary for Virginia's 1st Congressional District and will face Republican Rep. Rob Wittman in November.
The Virginia Mercury reported that she was first elected commonwealth's attorney in 2011 and is a native of Charlottesville.
She was previously a prosecutor in Richmond and a special assistant in the U.S. Attorney's office, and lost the 2025 Democratic primary for attorney general to Jay Jones.

sources.title: Shannon Taylor launches bid to represent Virginia's 1st Congressional District
